title: Malaysia Election Commission reports suspected cyberattack on its website during Melaka early voting
what_changed: The only source was a breach tracker. It is replaced by Bernama (10 Nov 2026), which quotes EC chairman Ramlan Harun. The website was 'believed to be facing a cyber attack threat', so the record now calls it a suspected attack, not a confirmed hit, and states no impact. The sentence saying the impact was under investigation was replaced by what Bernama reports.
